reason: Each FR-06 bullet maps to an assertion that fails on violation. (1) No Session in the business layer: test_fr06.py:68-69 fail on any sqlalchemy import or `Session` name outside repository/ and models/. (2) One Session per request, commit on success, rollback on exception: :85-86 (rows rolled back, session closed), :98-99 (rows committed), :229-231 (the get_session dependency rolls back and releases), and :206 (no connections left checked out). (3) No string-built SQL: :123 fails on any f-string, `+`, `%` or `.format` that contains a SQL keyword in src. (4) Eager loading: :163 fails on any `relationship()` in models without lazy=selectin/joined, and :154 requires the SELECT count to stay equal between 5 and 50 rows. (5) Connection pool: :172 compares pool.size() with the env value 7, and :173 requires pre_ping to be True. All 9 tests in the file pass. One weakness: src/ has no `relationship()` today, so :154 is trivially constant and :163 is the only real guard on N+1.

gaps.message: No relationship() exists in src, so the constant-SELECT-count check at test_fr06.py:154 passes trivially. Only the static lazy= check at :163 guards N+1, and it does not detect loop-per-row queries in repository code outside list_page.
